groups.name: streamrune.crypto
groups.description: Crypto engine configuration (immutable; bound once at startup).

groups.name: streamrune.crypto.aws.data-key-cache
groups.description: The AWS KMS engine's cache of plaintext data keys; off whenever streamrune.crypto.cache.enabled=false.

properties.name: streamrune.snapshot-every-n-events
properties.description: Number of events between automatic snapshots.

properties.name: streamrune.retry-max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum retry attempts on optimistic lock failure.

properties.name: streamrune.retry-initial-delay-ms
properties.description: Initial delay in milliseconds before first retry.

properties.name: streamrune.retry-backoff-multiplier
properties.description: Multiplier applied to delay between successive retries.

properties.name: streamrune.polling-interval-ms
properties.description: Catch-up polling interval in milliseconds for the auto-configured continuous projection runner's event subscriptions.

properties.name: streamrune.polling-jitter-ms
properties.description: Random jitter in milliseconds added to the polling interval to avoid thundering herd.

properties.name: streamrune.lock-timeout
properties.description: Lock acquisition timeout.

properties.name: streamrune.stripe-count
properties.description: Number of stripes for striped locker.

properties.name: streamrune.circuit-breaker-failure-threshold
properties.description: Number of consecutive failures before circuit opens.

properties.name: streamrune.circuit-breaker-cooldown
properties.description: How long to wait in OPEN state before probing.

properties.name: streamrune.event-audit-enabled
properties.description: Whether event audit trail is enabled.

properties.name: streamrune.projection-dlq-enabled
properties.description: Whether projection dead letter queue is enabled.

properties.name: streamrune.validation-enabled
properties.description: Whether command validation interceptor is enabled.

properties.name: streamrune.startup-log
properties.description: Whether to log StreamRune banner at startup.

properties.name: streamrune.saga.enabled
properties.description: Enable saga auto-configuration.

properties.name: streamrune.saga.forward-fence
properties.description: The forward fence of the SagaRunner beans whose builder named none: auto follows streamrune.subscription.single-active-consumer.enabled, on fences, off does not. With the fence on, the event store refuses a forward command of a saga whose compensation has begun or whose row is gone, in the transaction that would store it. A runner's own forwardFence(...) wins. YAML: quote "on"/"off" or use true/false.

properties.name: streamrune.outbox.enabled
properties.description: Enable outbox polling (opt-in, requires message broker).

properties.name: streamrune.outbox.batch-size
properties.description: Max events per outbox poll cycle.

properties.name: streamrune.outbox.flush-interval-ms
properties.description: Outbox polling interval in milliseconds.

properties.name: streamrune.dead-letter.enabled
properties.description: Enable the automatic dead letter retry runner. Only the automatic replays: the command bus keeps dead-lettering into a DeadLetterQueue bean and the retention sweeper keeps pruning it.

properties.name: streamrune.dead-letter.max-retries
properties.description: Max retry attempts before permanent failure.

properties.name: streamrune.dead-letter.retry-interval-ms
properties.description: Interval between retry attempts in milliseconds.

properties.name: streamrune.dead-letter.retention-max-age
properties.description: How long to keep command dead-letter-queue entries (which hold command payloads) before the retention sweeper prunes them; zero or negative disables pruning. Independent of streamrune.dead-letter.enabled. Must not exceed streamrune.inbox.retention-max-age when a command inbox is configured, or startup fails: an entry that outlives its key's inbox row would execute its command again on a retry.

properties.name: streamrune.dead-letter.unkeyed-replay
properties.description: Whether the automatic dead-letter retry replays entries of commands that ran without an idempotency key: operator-only (default) - they stay in the queue until an operator retries or discards them; automatic - they are replayed like keyed entries, a second execution whenever the caller already retried the command successfully. Any other value fails startup.

properties.name: streamrune.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Enable Micrometer metrics publishing.

properties.name: streamrune.metrics.prefix
properties.description: Metric name prefix.

properties.name: streamrune.gdpr.snapshot-purge
properties.description: Whether the auto-configured ForgetSubjectService must run a SnapshotPurger bean: required (default) - declare one (for PostgresEventStore a PostgresSnapshotStorePurger), or the application does not start, because a snapshot keeps every field of the aggregate state not marked @Encrypted in the clear; none - the application has never stored a snapshot. Any other value fails startup.

properties.name: streamrune.subscription.single-active-consumer.enabled
properties.description: Enable single-active-consumer subscription leadership so at most one replica of each projection/subscription is the active consumer (requires a DataSource); when false, runners always lead (single-instance behavior). The leadership bean and the saga forward fence's auto read this value through one parser: true/false, on/off, yes/no, y/n, t/f and 1/0, case-insensitive; any other value fails startup.

properties.name: streamrune.subscription.health.lag-threshold
properties.description: Lag, in events between the head of the event stream and a subscription's checkpoint, at or above which a running subscription is reported DEGRADED in the health details. Lag never turns the StreamRune health indicator DOWN, so it is safe in the readiness group: only a stopped or terminally halted subscription does. At least 1.

properties.name: streamrune.query-cache.enabled
properties.description: Whether CachingQueryBus is auto-configured.

properties.name: streamrune.event-store.schema.auto-initialize
properties.description: Whether the event store auto-creates / migrates its schema on startup (Flyway). Disable to manage schema externally.

properties.name: streamrune.event-store.statement-timeout
properties.description: Bound on every statement the event store runs, applied per transaction or per statement (never on the pooled session). 0 sets no bound of the store's own.

properties.name: streamrune.security.trust-user-id-header
properties.description: Trusted-gateway mode: take the request identity (RequestContext.userId) from the X-User-Id header, even when Spring Security is present. Enable only when a gateway in front of the service authenticates every caller, overwrites X-User-Id with the authenticated id and strips any client-supplied value, and the service is reachable only through it. When false (the default) the identity is the authenticated principal (an AuthenticatedUserResolver, e.g. Spring Security); without one every request is anonymous, the header is ignored, and a configured CommandAuthorizationPolicy or annotation authorization refuses startup.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.cache.enabled
properties.description: Whether the decrypted-plaintext crypto cache wraps the engine. false skips the cache entirely so no decrypted PII is retained in heap (the no-cache GDPR posture).

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.cache.maximum-size
properties.description: Maximum number of entries in the crypto cache.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.cache.expire-after-write
properties.description: Duration after which a cached crypto entry expires once written; also the only cross-replica erasure bound when no DataSource wires the forget channel.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.cache.expire-after-access
properties.description: Duration after which a cached crypto entry expires when not accessed. Unset disables access-based expiry.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.filesystem.enabled
properties.description: Enable the file system crypto engine.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.filesystem.key-directory
properties.description: Directory holding the file system engine's encryption keys. Required when the engine is enabled.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.postgres.enabled
properties.description: Enable the PostgreSQL crypto engine.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.postgres.table-name
properties.description: Key-table name of the PostgreSQL engine; must be a plain SQL identifier. The shipped migration creates only the default-named table, so a custom name requires creating that table.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.vault.enabled
properties.description: Enable the HashiCorp Vault crypto engine.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.vault.address
properties.description: Vault server address.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.vault.token
properties.description: Vault authentication token. Required when the Vault engine is enabled.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.vault.engine-mount
properties.description: Mount path of the Vault transit engine.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.aws.enabled
properties.description: Enable the AWS KMS crypto engine.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.aws.region
properties.description: AWS region of the KMS key. Required when the AWS KMS engine is enabled.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.aws.kms-key-id
properties.description: AWS KMS key id or ARN. Required when the AWS KMS engine is enabled.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.aws.data-key-cache.maximum-size
properties.description: Data keys the AWS KMS engine caches per map (one per subject for encryption, one per subject and data key for decryption); 0 disables the data-key cache, so every value costs one KMS call. Ignored (0) when streamrune.crypto.cache.enabled=false.

properties.name: streamrune.crypto.aws.data-key-cache.expire-after-write
properties.description: How long a cached plaintext data key lives after it was stored; must be positive. Expired keys leave the heap at the next cache store or eviction, or at a lookup at most once a second.

properties.name: streamrune.inbox.retention-max-age
properties.description: How long processed command-inbox rows are kept; 0 or negative keeps them.

properties.name: streamrune.max-in-flight-async-commands
properties.description: executeAsync commands admitted and not yet complete beyond which the next one is refused.

properties.name: streamrune.metadata.baggage-allowlist
properties.description: OpenTelemetry baggage keys a request may carry into event metadata; none by default.

properties.name: streamrune.outbox.retention-max-age
properties.description: How long delivered entries are kept; 0 or negative keeps them.

properties.name: streamrune.outbox.retry-initial-delay-ms
properties.description: First retry delay, in milliseconds; it grows by the multiplier, up to 60s.

properties.name: streamrune.outbox.retry-max-attempts
properties.description: Delivery attempts a rejected entry may accrue before it is FAILED.

properties.name: streamrune.outbox.retry-multiplier
properties.description: Factor by which the retry delay grows with each attempt.

properties.name: streamrune.outbox.skipped-retention-max-age
properties.description: How long skipped entries are kept; 0 or negative keeps them.

properties.name: streamrune.projections.auto-discovery.enabled
properties.description: Whether the integration builds and starts the runners of the @ProjectionConfig projections.

properties.name: streamrune.saga.compensation-retry-enabled
properties.description: Whether the compensation-retry sweeper re-drives stuck compensations; false leaves it sampling the gauges.

properties.name: streamrune.saga.compensation-retry-give-up-after
properties.description: How long a saga may stay COMPENSATING before the sweeper faults it.

properties.name: streamrune.saga.compensation-retry-interval
properties.description: How often the sweeper re-drives, and the age an episode reaches before it is re-driven.

properties.name: streamrune.saga.dead-letter-retention-max-age
properties.description: How long saga dead letters are kept; at most the inbox window.

properties.name: streamrune.sse.enabled
properties.description: Whether the Server-Sent Events endpoint and its feed exist.

properties.name: streamrune.sse.keep-alive-interval
properties.description: Interval of the keepalive comment frame; 0 or negative writes none.

properties.name: streamrune.sse.polling-interval
properties.description: How often the feed reads the global stream; at least 1ms.

properties.name: streamrune.sse.timeout
properties.description: How long a stream stays open; 0 or negative sets no timeout.

properties.name: streamrune.subscription.single-active-consumer.lease-ttl
properties.description: How long a lease outlives its last renewal: the bound on failover.
